note: Machine-readable counterpart of the provenance prose in src/tests/catalog_data.rs. `generatedAt` is the commit timestamp of the NEWEST pi revision any of 35 embedded catalogs under providers/catalog/*.json was extracted from — b0c2a90e (2026-07-17T09:00:03Z, its commit timestamp in UTC), the revision amazon-bedrock.json, github-copilot.json, google-vertex.json and openai-codex.json came from; the other 31 came from 91585d9a (2026-07-10T16:34:43Z). It is the staleness floor for the pi.dev overlay (DRIFT-007): a persisted remote catalog whose Last-Modified is not strictly newer than this is discarded whole, so upgrading cyrup can never leave a pre-upgrade overlay shadowing freshly refreshed embedded data. PROV-039: the value must be the LATEST extraction revision, not the earliest — an overlay dated between the two was previously accepted and could shadow the newer embedded rows, because catalog.rs:9-12 lets an overlay REPLACE a model by id. Bump this in the same commit that refreshes the catalogs (PROV-018's `xtask gen-catalogs` must rewrite it).
